findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_changes, search_articles, get_calendar_feed_url · Private data: get_plans, how_to_connect, get_org, get_event_storylines, search_fighters, get_fighter, get_leaderboard, get_record_book, get_judge_scorecards, list_split_decisions, get_calendar_feed_url, create_webhook_endpoint, rotate_webhook_secret · Public sink: get_event_card, how_to_watch, get_broadcast_rights, list_webhook_endpoints, create_webhook_endpoint, rotate_webhook_secret, delete_webhook_endpoint · Destructive: delete_webhook_endpoint.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_changes, search_articles, get_calendar_feed_url · Private data: get_plans, how_to_connect, get_org, get_event_storylines, search_fighters, get_fighter, get_leaderboard, get_record_book, get_judge_scorecards, list_split_decisions, get_calendar_feed_url, create_webhook_endpoint, rotate_webhook_secret · Public sink: get_event_card, how_to_watch, get_broadcast_rights, list_webhook_endpoints, create_webhook_endpoint, rotate_webhook_secret, delete_webhook_endpoint · Destructive: delete_webhook_endpoint

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
